page_title: ORANO — AI That Understands Reels & Videos

sources.entry: ORANO - Turns saved Reels, TikToks, YouTube videos, articles and PDFs into searchable summaries and step-by-step plans. #freemium

summary.name: ORANO
summary.one_liner: ORANO is an app and web tool that watches saved Reels, TikToks, YouTube and other videos, then returns a summary, key takeaways, and next steps.
use_cases: Turn a saved Reel or TikTok into a step-by-step plan
Get key picks from a recommendation video
Search across saved videos and articles
Give an AI agent access to a personal video library
summary.what_it_does: ORANO takes a shared Reel, pasted video link, or uploaded video and analyzes speech, visuals, on-screen text, and source context together. It returns a summary and key takeaways, and turns actionable videos (such as recipes) into steps while keeping explainers as clear summaries. It also accepts articles, PDFs, carousels, posts, and repositories. Users can ask questions across their saved library. ORANO MCP lets compatible agents such as ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, and Ollama read and, with full-access keys, save and manage projects, tasks, and memory.
notable: Analyzes speech, visuals, on-screen text and source context together
ORANO MCP connects personal library to agents like ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor and Ollama
caveats: ORANO Pro is an optional in-app subscription; current plans and prices are shown by Apple and Google
Agent access through ORANO MCP is a separate $5/month web plan
